name: mako-edifact-sanitizer
description: Offline-first EDIFACT pseudonymization aid for synthetic MaKo case sharing.

scripts.smoke: node bin/mako-edifact-sanitizer.js fixtures/mscons.synthetic.edi --out /tmp/mako-edifact-sanitized.edi --report /tmp/mako-edifact-report.json && node -e "const fs=require('fs'); const r=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('/tmp/mako-edifact-report.json','utf8')); if(!r.summary || !r.replacementsByClass) process.exit(1); console.log('smoke ok')"
